requirement_vague: Verify the superuser (admin@example.com / password123) can change their own password and change it back.

implementation.reasoning: The startup logic creates the superuser with email admin@example.com and password password123 if it does not already exist. The login endpoint authenticates by email/password and issues an access token, and the authenticated PATCH /users/me/password endpoint verifies the current password, updates the stored hash, and returns 200 with message='Password updated successfully', which supports changing the password and then changing it back; subsequent logins use the updated stored hash via authenticate().
